note.en: Median of 19 standard-leather listings on Fashionphile. Sotheby’s puts pristine Togo 25s at $28–30k.
note.zh: Fashionphile 上 19 个常规皮 Birkin 25 挂牌价的中位数。苏富比称全新品相的 Togo 25 成交约 2.8–3 万美元。

note.en: Guides cite $20–26k for pristine or excellent classic-leather Kelly 25s; the typical figure is that band’s midpoint. Pristine Sellier reaches $26–32k.
note.zh: 多份指南给出全新/极好品相 Kelly 25 的价位为 2–2.6 万美元，典型价取中值。全新外缝款可达 2.6–3.2 万美元。

note.en: All sizes and materials. Listings are mostly vintage, which drags the median down; recent flaps in excellent condition trade 15–30% below retail.
note.zh: 涵盖全部尺寸和材质。样本以中古为主，拉低了中位价；近年款极好品相通常比公价低 15–30%。

note.en: All sizes combined.
note.zh: 全部尺寸合并统计。

note.en: Trades daily. Classic colours hold value better than seasonal shades.
note.zh: 每天都有成交，经典色比季节色更保值。

note.en: The source publishes a median only, with no range or sample size.
note.zh: 来源只公布了中位价，没有价格区间和样本量。

note.en: Aggregate of resale listings across Rebag, The RealReal, Vestiaire Collective and eBay.
note.zh: 汇总自 Rebag、The RealReal、Vestiaire Collective 和 eBay 的二手挂牌。

retail_note.en: Retail is the Margaux 15 in leather ($4,700). The Margaux left third-party stores in 2025 and now sells only in The Row’s boutiques, which keeps resale high.
retail_note.zh: 公价取皮革 Margaux 15 的 4700 美元。Margaux 2025 年起只在 The Row 自营门店销售，二手价因此偏高。

note.en: April 2026 market value from 72 observations; the median Chrono24 ask was $71,200. The range spans the past two years.
note.zh: 2026 年 4 月基于 72 个样本的市场估值，Chrono24 挂牌中位价 71,200 美元。区间为近两年高低点。

note.zh: 2026 款三节链带二手挂牌，典型价取中值。上一代 79030N 约 2809 美元。

note.en: Black dial, steel bracelet. Range is Chrono24 listings by condition.
note.zh: 黑盘钢带款。区间为 Chrono24 不同品相的挂牌价。

note.en: Market value $6,501. Current dealer asks run $6,750 (full set, like new) to $8,650 (new).

note.en: Excellent condition with papers. Diamond versions keep less: the four-diamond sells for $7.5–9.5k against $11,100 retail.
note.zh: 极好品相、带证书。镶钻款保值较差：四钻款公价 11,100 美元，二手 7,500–9,500 美元。

note.en: Popular pieces resell at 80–110% of retail; the typical figure uses 90%. A 1stDibs listing currently asks $8,000.
note.zh: 热门款二手价为公价的 80–110%，典型价按 90% 计。1stDibs 上有一条挂牌价 8000 美元。

note.en: Average retention of about 95% across versions. Resale runs from $2,450 to $16,995 depending on size, gold and diamonds.
note.zh: 各版本平均保值率约 95%。二手价从 2450 到 16,995 美元不等，取决于尺寸、金色和是否镶钻。

items.zh: Trinity 三色金戒指 经典款

note.en: Classic 18k model. Resale depends heavily on size and band wear; the typical figure is the midpoint.
note.zh: 18K 经典款。二手价很受尺寸和戒圈磨损影响，典型价取中值。

items.name: Perlée collection
src: The Luxury Closet · VCA resale guide

note.en: Perlée pieces typically keep 50–70% of retail, well below Alhambra. The figure shown is the midpoint.
note.zh: Perlée 系列通常保值 50–70%，明显低于四叶草系列，此处取中值。

note.en: The Row and Toteme cashmere resells for about 40–60% of retail. The figure shown is the midpoint.
note.zh: The Row 和 Toteme 的羊绒单品二手约为公价的 40–60%，此处取中值。

note.en: Retail is the SS26 price; resale mostly covers older seasons. On The RealReal a 2022 jacket asked $3,485 and a 2026 blazer $6,945.
note.zh: 公价为 2026 春夏新款价，二手多为往季款。The RealReal 上 2022 年款挂牌 3485 美元，2026 年款挂牌 6945 美元。

note.en: Last completed sale of an FW21 Night Blue Maya. One sale is a thin sample.
note.zh: FW21 夜蓝色 Maya 的最近一笔成交。只有一笔成交，样本很少。

note.en: Two eBay listings: a vintage coat at $500 and an unworn one at $1,190. The typical figure is their midpoint.
note.zh: 两条 eBay 挂牌：中古款 500 美元，未穿过的 1190 美元。典型价取两者中值。

note.en: Estimated from the 30–50% of retail that good-condition luxury outerwear typically fetches. Vintage trenches range from £150 to over £2,000.
note.zh: 按奢侈品外套好品相通常卖到公价 30–50% 估算。中古风衣价格从 150 英镑到 2000 多英镑不等。

note.en: Plain cashmere listed at about a fifth of retail on The RealReal. Baby cashmere and Piuma hold 40–55%. No dollar figures were published.
note.zh: The RealReal 上基础款羊绒毛衣的挂牌价约为公价的五分之一；小山羊绒和 Piuma 系列能保住 40–55%。来源未给出具体金额。
